_about: Generated by scripts/train_closure_forecast.py; rerun it rather than editing. Cox proportional hazards, stratified by service, one-hot neighborhood. Historical chance of closure (any closure, including Noted or Transitioned) within horizonDays, given a request still open after N whole days. No case-level records.

release.summary: Held-out Brier score 0.06691 vs 0.06778 for Kaplan–Meier, 1.3% lower where 5% lower was required; calibration error 0.0157 vs 0.0189; worst major service Overflowing Trash +1.1%.
release.testWindow: opened 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-17, followed to the extract cutoff 2026-10-24 09:01 UTC
